yearOnly.note: You can start with just a birth year. Anything that needs your full date or time is shown in dashed outline for now, and fills in automatically once you add it.

date.label: Date of birth
date.leapHint: Tick this only if that lunar year had a leap month and you were born in the second one. We’ll let you know if that year didn’t have one.
date.ganZhiHint: Finds matching Gregorian dates between 1900 and 2100 from your pillars. If you include the hour pillar, we’ll set the birth time to the middle of that two-hour period.
date.candidates: {count, plural, =0 {No matching dates found between 1900 and 2100} one {Found # matching date — select it below} other {Found # matching dates — choose one below}}
date.pillarsRequired: Please look up the matching dates and choose one to continue.

notes.exact: We’ll cast your charts to the exact minute from your birth certificate or family records.
notes.plusMinus15m: We’ll check 15 minutes either side and flag anything in your reading that could shift within that window.
notes.plusMinus1h: Within a two-hour window, your Ascendant, houses, hour pillar, Zi Wei Life Palace and a few Energy Blueprint gates may cross a boundary — we’ll clearly mark any reading that depends on them.
notes.shichenOnly: We’ll use the midpoint of that two-hour period, and mark anything that relies on the exact minute — such as your Ascendant, houses and faster-moving gates — as tentative.
notes.unknown: Charts can still be cast without a birth time. BaZi uses the year, month and day pillars without an hour pillar, Western astrology leaves out the Ascendant and houses, Zi Wei Dou Shu is not cast without the hour, and Energy Blueprint shows the type with a note that it needs the time to be confirmed. Every part that depends on the time is drawn with dashed lines with the reason. Birth details can be edited at any time to recalculate all charts. With an account — for you or an adult profile you fill in yourself — birth-time inference can also work out the most likely time from clues such as a rough time family remembers, dated life events, a few distinguishing questions and, for your own profile, palm and face observations.

place.label: Place of birth
place.search: Search for a city or town
place.noResults: We couldn’t find “{query}”. Try a nearby city, or enter the coordinates directly.
place.manual: Enter coordinates and time zone manually
place.tzNote: We check the IANA historical database to account for time-zone changes and daylight saving in the year you were born.
place.dataNote: Place data comes from GeoNames (around 37,000 cities and towns worldwide, CC BY 4.0). If your birthplace isn’t listed, you can enter its coordinates directly.
place.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the list of places. Please check your connection and try again, or enter the coordinates directly.
place.required: Please choose a place of birth

sex.label: Sex for calculation
sex.note: Used only for traditional chart calculations: in BaZi it decides whether your ten-year luck cycles run forwards or backwards, and Zi Wei Dou Shu needs it to cast a chart at all. If you skip this, BaZi will show both luck-cycle directions and Zi Wei will wait until you add it.

timeCertainty.degradedNote: Anything that depends on the hour of birth is shown with a dashed line. Add your birth time and the chart will recalculate automatically.
